about: GP output chain defaults (tools/gpchain/chain.py). Decision VES-2611 on F-439: the f439 route is the default stage on repaired fits only; any other fit takes the f429 route and chain.json logs why. villa / VC3D defaults are untouched (every option here is an opt-in flag of our own tools).
repaired_rule: the fit directory holds fold_repair.json (tools/gpchain/fold_repair.py, F-438 route) whose out_sha256 equals the fit's own x/y/z.tif

f429.why: F-439: stock density-4 quads cross unrepaired tears (36 quads > 4x median on unrepaired w130, 0 on the F-438 repaired fit), and the rim fill can extend a triangle across a tear
